description: Map of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health and Medical Services is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Indigenous HealthInfoNet. This interactive map of Australia enables you to search for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health/Medical Services by state or territory. The above text is an excerpt from "Map of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander health/medical services" released by Australian Indigenous HealthInfoNet under a Creative Commons BY-NC-ND 3.0 (CC BY-NC-ND 3.0) licence. Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY-NC (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
